Hi Stephen,

Thanks for doing that test and for the video, it tells us what we needed to know.

With the unit plugged straight into an outlet you have proven works, and no link activity at all on the router when you plug the ethernet cable in, this is no longer pointing at the power lead. A unit that is dark and silent on the network side is almost always the board itself, which is a warranty matter rather than something you can fix at home.

So I have put your order, Shop····, the Airsquitter delivered on June 23, in front of JD, our hardware lead, and Georges, who makes the warranty call. The team is offline for the night and picks this up tomorrow from 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you by email in this thread. You do not need to send anything twice.

Two things that will speed it up if you can reply with them: a clear photo of the serial number label on the unit, and confirmation that nobody has opened or modified it. If you would rather talk to JD directly and sooner, he is very active on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where he shows as JD, @nullhashrate.

I am sorry it went dark on you after only a few months of use. We will get you an answer.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you and 100% the jet vision box have never been opened      Lmk if
you need anything else

Hi Stephen,

That is everything we needed, thank you. I have the serial, ····, and your confirmation that the unit has never been opened, both on your file with the video.

Our technical side has looked at it and agrees with what you found: the unit itself has failed, not the power lead. The return is now with JD and Georges for approval, which is the last step before we can set it up. They are offline for the evening and pick this up tomorrow from 10am Eastern, and the confirmation comes to you by email in this thread.

Once it is approved I will send you a prepaid return label for the unit, along with a reference number to write on the outside of the box, and we will sort out what goes back to you. Nothing is needed from you until that label arrives, so please keep the unit and its box safe in the meantime and do not ship anything yet.

Sorry again that it died on you this early. I will stay on it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
